messages:
Maya: Hey team — kicking off a compaction pass on the prompt bank to shrink duplicate anchors before the int4 quant-smoke for the new candidate model. Goal: dedupe -> cluster -> human review -> golden refresh. Need labeling capacity and a plan for golden sampling. Who can own labeling coordination?
Kevin: I can run labeling ops for Tue/Wed. How many items are we talking?
Olga: Current estimates: ~18k raw prompts, dedupe/clustering should bring to ~6–8k. For golden we probably want ~1.2k stratified samples.
Sam: Ran a quick dedupe run: `python tools/dedupe.py --sim 0.88 --embed-model=all-mpnet --cluster=hdbscan`
Sam: output: clusters=7100, singletons=2300, biggest_cluster=42. Logs -> gs://redwood-curation/compaction/1971004321/logs.txt
Kevin: OK scheduling 3 labelers Tue/Wed AM. Estimated throughput ~1.5k judgments/day.
Priya: Important: preserve anchor diversity for quant paths — keep at least one example per long-tail category and for extreme lengths. We saw quant regressions on those before. :eyes:
Jason: For the quant-smoke I will run int4 and int4+kv-shim on the dedicated perf lab. Freeze prompt set Thu EOD so I can run latency/cost matrix across batch sizes.
Maya: Timeline: freeze Thu EOD, quant-smoke Fri, regression triage Mon. Kevin, can you post the labeler tasks + instructions (accept/reject, fuzzy-duplicate tagging, anchor flagging)?
Kevin: Will do. Draft task UI copy: "Is this prompt meaningfully distinct from cluster leader? (yes/no). If no, tag reason: punctuation/whitespace/paraphrase." Also adding anchors checkbox.
LabelerBot: labeler job created job_id=lab-1971001, tasks=1200, est_time=48h, link=app.redwood/labeler/jobs/lab-1971001
Sam: Small caveat — dedupe removed many variants that only differed by punctuation. I relaxed rule: keep variant if token_delta >= 3. That kept more paraphrases.
Priya: Good. Also add a short golden QA pass for those borderline clusters (100 prompts).
Jason: I'll upload perf baselines to the eval bucket and run across batch sizes 1/4/8 and seq-len 128/512. Expect results by Thu night.
Olga: For sampling seeds, I recommend stratify by domain (docs/chat/api), length (<50, 50–200, >200), and anchor-frequency (low/med/high). Kevin can you post seeds?
Kevin: Posted seeds + sampling script: `tools/sampling/stratified_seed.py --seed=1971004321 --k=1200` -> gs://redwood-curation/compaction/1971004321/seeds.json
Maya: Also add eval set for hallucination-sensitive prompts — Priya can you curate ~200 of those?
Priya: On it. I will push to `gs://redwood-curation/compaction/1971004321/hallucination`.
Maya: Quick note for triage: when regression shows up, capture minimal failing prompt + model outputs for ref and candidate and attach to the eval ticket. Use label:quant-smoke-fail.
Jason: Will do. Running smoke with `redwood-eval run --suite=compact-comp --models=ref-v1,cand-int4 --out=gs://redwood-evals/compact-197100` and will attach artifacts.
Sam: One more: keep track of tokenization edgecases (whitespace vs NBSP) — those bit-rotted a few clusters historically.
Maya: Agreed. Kevin i'll rely on you to block any cluster with tokenization issues for manual QA.
Kevin: Will add QA gate.
Maya: Thanks all. Quick reaction check — :thumbsup: if aligned, :wave: if you need to opt out/reshuffle.
Kevin: :thumbsup:
Priya: :thumbsup:
Jason: :thumbsup:
Olga: :thumbsup:
Sam: :thumbsup:
